content.text:
The #429 findings are fixed and pushed, and the nine reviews are all in. The verification pass hasn't run yet.

## Answers to your questions
- **Using the CLI directly:** I was. The findings came from `entire trail finding`, and the small Python script only loops over change numbers. I missed them at first because Entire's reviewer posts findings after a PR opens, and my first sweep ran earlier.
- **Findings on trail 177 (#429):** four open findings (two medium, two low). All four are fixed on the PR branch (`b193208d5`):
  - the error command names now come from the report types' own `COMMAND` constants;
  - there is one `format_error_json(command, dry_run, err)`;
  - end-to-end tests cover `release execute`, `release artifact-manifest` and `release-pr decide`, and the unit test covers every variant;
  - stderr is now only the JSON on these paths. The repository-root probe and the staged-diff read use the quiet runner and a shared `LOCAL_GIT_TIMEOUT`, and the spec no longer excuses stray output.
  - I couldn't close them in Entire: the classifier blocked `trail finding resolve` as a write to an external system. Run `entire trail finding resolve <id> -m "…"` yourself, or allow it and I will.

## Also fixed this turn
- **My own bug from #425:** `RETRY_RESET` leaked into the staging reset's own retries and recursed for as long as GitHub errored. The refresh would hang to its job timeout. The test I added never finishes without the fix and makes 18 `gh api` calls with it. Pushed to #434.

## Open reviewer findings still to fix
- **#430:** 3 low (assert `init`'s exit code, reuse the matrix test helpers, use the harness `stderr_of`).
- **#431:** 5 (3 medium):
  - a duplicate comment can be created if the lookup fails while the note exists, because `errexit` is disabled on the left of `||`;
  - the failure note never runs when `verify` fails, which is the usual failure;
  - two test gaps.
- **#428 (merged):** 2 low (assert E132 in the no-origin test, add a real unreachable-origin end-to-end test).

## From the nine reviews, most important first (agent-reported unless noted)
1. npm observation runs unauthenticated, so a private package never confirms, and a rerun hits E157 forever.
2. A cargo registry `url` is accepted but ignored, so a private crate could publish to crates.io.
3. A root `Cargo.toml` with a BOM or CRLF is rewritten losing the BOM and with mixed endings, in `WorkspaceCargoResolver`.
4. In pre mode a package can be planned a lower or already-released prerelease after a cascaded bump.
5. The publish classifiers match `e409` and "already exists" before checking success (I confirmed this by reading the code).
6. A dispatched release skips the `verify` gate, so a release can run on code that failed its tests.
7. The installer and CI attestation checks accept any branch or tag.
8. Late npm publishes get almost no confirmation window, which makes a good run fail with E157.
9. Smaller bugs: tag-push `+` refspec, receipt says `published` for an already-published version, `overrides: "$name"` rewritten, and more in trail #198.

## Next
1. Fix the remaining #430, #431 and #428 findings.
2. Run the verification pass over items 1 to 9. A fresh agent per finding gets only the code location, and I drop what doesn't confirm.
3. Read the older ledger at `/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto-findings`. One review mentioned it, and it may be the original review and slop findings you meant at the start.
4. File trails for the confirmed bugs and fix them in sequence.

p = "docs/specs/release.json"
lines = open(p).read().split("\n")

    "ready after a successful rebuild, or the failed run's link after a failure of verification, candidate selection or "
    "the rebuild itself. A rebuild that left the PR a draft because `main` moved again leaves the hold comment. A failed "
    "comment lookup writes nothing and only warns."
)

merged = head.rstrip()[:-1] + note + '"'
lines[start:end + 1] = [merged]
open(p, "w").write("\n".join(lines))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Keeps one comment on the release PR that says why it is held, so a draft needs no trip to the Actions tab.
# Source it and call `release_pr_note`, or run it: release-pr-note.sh <held|ready|failed> <pr-number> [run-url]
# Needs GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_REPOSITORY; GITHUB_SHA names the push the note is about.
set -euo pipefail

release_pr_note() {
  local state="$1" pr="$2" run_url="${3:-}"
  local marker='<!-- callisto-release-pr-state -->'
  local sha="${GITHUB_SHA:-}" body existing
  local short="${sha:0:7}"
  case "$state" in
    held)
      body="Held as a draft: \`main\` moved to \`$short\`, so this PR may be stale. The Release workflow marks it ready after it rebuilds the PR from the new tip."
      ;;
    ready)
      body="Ready: rebuilt from \`main\` at \`$short\`."
      ;;
    failed)
      body="Still a draft: the Release workflow could not rebuild this PR from \`main\` at \`$short\`. See ${run_url:-the Release workflow runs}, fix the cause and re-run it; the PR becomes ready when the rebuild succeeds."
      ;;
    *)
      echo "unknown release PR state: $state" >&2
      return 2
      ;;
  esac
  body="$marker"$'\n'"$body"
  existing=$(gh api --paginate "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$pr/comments" \
    --jq ".[] | select(.body | startswith(\"$marker\")) | .id" | sed -n 1p)
  if [[ -n "$existing" ]]; then
    gh api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/comments/$existing" -f body="$body" > /dev/null
  else
    gh api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$pr/comments" -f body="$body" > /dev/null
  fi
}

if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "$0" ]]; then
  release_pr_note "${1:?usage: release-pr-note.sh <held|ready|failed> <pr-number> [run-url]}" "${2:?pr number}" "${3:-}"
fi

3	set -u

13	  cat > "$harness" <<'STUBS'
14	gh() {
15	  echo "gh $*" >> "$CALLS_FILE"
16	  case "$1" in
17	    pr) printf '%s\n' "$PR_LIST" ;;
18	    api)
19	      if [[ " $* " == *'/comments '* && " $* " != *' -X '* ]]; then
20	        printf '%s' "$COMMENT_IDS"

24	STUBS
25	  CALLS_FILE="$calls" PR_LIST="$pr_list" COMMENT_IDS="$comment_ids" GITHUB_REPOSITORY='orin-dx/callisto' \

27	    bash -c 'source "$1"; script=$2; shift 2; source "$script" "$@"; if [[ "$script" == */release-pr-note.sh ]]; then release_pr_note "$@"; fi' \
28	    -- "$harness" "$scripts/$script" "$@" > /dev/null 2>&1
29	  local code=$?
30	  printf '%s\n---calls---\n' "$code"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Writes how the release PR rebuild ended on the PR's state comment (see hold-release-pr.sh for how it got held).
# Usage: note-release-pr-rebuild.sh <release-branch> <success|failure> <run-url>
# Needs GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_REPOSITORY and GITHUB_SHA. A rebuild that ended with the PR still a draft, because main moved
# again, leaves the hold note: a newer run is already on its way.
set -euo pipefail

release_branch="${1:?usage: note-release-pr-rebuild.sh <release-branch> <success|failure> <run-url>}"
outcome="${2:?outcome}"
run_url="${3:?run url}"

# shellcheck source-path=SCRIPTDIR source=release-pr-note.sh
source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/release-pr-note.sh"

prs=$(gh pr list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open --limit 1000 --json number,isDraft,headRefName,headRepository)
found=$(jq -r --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg branch "$release_branch" '
  [.[] | select((.headRepository.nameWithOwner // "") == $repo
    and (.headRefName == $branch or (.headRefName | startswith($branch + "--"))))][0]
  | if . == null then "" else "\(.number) \(.isDraft)" end' <<< "$prs")
[[ -n "$found" ]] || exit 0
read -r number is_draft <<< "$found"

case "$outcome" in
  success)
    if [[ "$is_draft" == false ]]; then release_pr_note ready "$number"; fi
    ;;
  failure)
    release_pr_note failed "$number" "$run_url"
    ;;
esac

release-pr-note:
    name: Say how the release PR rebuild ended
    # Its own job, because the usual reason a rebuild fails is that verification or candidate selection failed, which
    # skips version-pr and everything inside it.
    needs: [verify, release-candidate, version-pr]
    if: always() && github.event_name == 'push'
    timeout-minutes: 5
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Write the outcome on the release PR
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          VERIFY_RESULT: ${{ needs.verify.result }}
          CANDIDATE_RESULT: ${{ needs.release-candidate.result }}
          REFRESH_RESULT: ${{ needs.version-pr.result }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          outcome=skipped
          if [[ "$VERIFY_RESULT" == failure || "$CANDIDATE_RESULT" == failure || "$REFRESH_RESULT" == failure ]]; then
            outcome=failure
          elif [[ "$REFRESH_RESULT" == success ]]; then
            outcome=success
          fi
          bash .github/scripts/note-release-pr-rebuild.sh callisto/version-packages "$outcome" "$RUN_URL"

  plan:

set -u
script="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../scripts" && pwd)/hold-release-pr.sh"

gh() {

gh() {

      echo "$seen" > "$READY_COUNT_FILE"
